title: MultiplayerSpawner does not autospawn the autospawn list path due to case sensitivity
body:
### Tested versions

Godot 4.4.1 Tested version


### System information

Windows 11 -v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6]

### Issue description

Overview:
The load() function does not care about casing when it comes to the path inputted. However the AutoSpawn list does care about sensitivity, and will not autospawn on the Clients Instance of the game when clearly my host has spawned the nodes.

I see this as a bug as case sensitivity does not matter for loading the scene, so why should it for the autospawnlist. Also I have pulled my github branch onto another computer so I feel like something has happened when I did this.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Have a running Multiplayer server with a host and a client instance.
2. Have a multiplayerspawner with atleast 1 autospawnlist element with the path having uppercasing.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/688571fc-d62b-44bb-9aa6-a673448baab0)
3. Load and instantiate the scene to the autopath but with lower casing.
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f5ae1213-6c52-4ac3-befd-08ae4af173a2)
4. The Host's scene will load the node 
Expected Result:
Clients will spawn the node as well
Actual Result: 
Nothing Happens

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

1. Make sure to run multiple instances.
2. Press Host Server button for 1 instance
3. Press Join Server button for another instance.
4. Host Spawns Player Scene in

Expected Result:
Clients will spawn the Player as well
Actual Result: 
Nothing Happens

[test-multiplayer-project.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20745265/test-multiplayer-project.zip)
